- Backend & Systems: Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3/4, C# 14, .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, RabbitMQ, Spring Security 6, JPA / Hibernate, Python 3.12, Django 5 (Service Layer, atomic transactions), RESTful APIs, Webhook idempotency, Microservices principles, JDBC without ORM, BigDecimal financial precision.

- Frontend & Mobile: TypeScript 6.0, React 18/19, React Native (Expo SDK 54), Angular 22 (Signals, OnPush), Vite, Three.js / WebGL, Framer Motion, Styled Components, CSS Modules, SCSS, HTML5, Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA & VLibras).

## Flagship Production Case Studies
- [ZEISS Recommendation Assistant](https://devyurivieira.vercel.app/#projects): Corporate MVP built with an 11-developer agile team for ZEISS Group. Automates ophthalmic prescription reading via non-blocking WebFlux streaming to an n8n OCR/RAG AI pipeline with Human-in-the-Loop confidence scoring, delivers habit-based ZEISS lens recommendations, and includes 3-tier RBAC JWT authentication and interactive ApexCharts sales dashboards. Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Styled Components, ApexCharts, Java 17, Spring Boot 4.1, PostgreSQL 18, n8n, OCR, RAG.
- [FleetOps API (C# 14 / .NET 10 / RabbitMQ / PostgreSQL)](https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/fleetops-api): Distributed fleet and logistics backend engine and corporate reference architecture in .NET 10. Implements Clean Architecture, DDD, Transactional Outbox pattern with RabbitMQ publishing (Publisher Confirms, TTL retry queues, Dead-Letter Queue), idempotent consumer (MessageId PK), PostgreSQL optimistic concurrency via xmin, and multi-replica FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED coordination. Covered by 300 automated tests (166 unit + 134 integration) in xUnit across 28 business endpoints, and 278 RPS ACID throughput in k6.
- [FarmFlow (Java 21 Virtual Threads / React Native Offline-First)](https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/farmflow-backend): Precision agriculture platform combining an Offline-First React Native mobile client (FIFO mutation queue, SHA-256 digital signatures for MAPA compliance) and a distributed Java 21 / Spring Boot 4 backend (Transactional Outbox, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL 17 time-series partitioning, ~845 req/s in-memory and ~293 req/s ACID transactional writes in k6) backed by 583 automated tests (445 backend + 138 mobile in 26 Jest suites).
- [Work-Fitness Commercial Platform](https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/Work-Fitness): Production commercial platform and biomechanical assessment engine (WHO BMI, Deurenberg body fat, Mifflin-St Jeor BMR) built in Vanilla TypeScript 5.7 & Vite 6 with Clean Architecture, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility + VLibras, 100/100 Lighthouse score, 32 kB bundle, 170 Vitest unit tests, and 47 Playwright E2E specs across 26 viewports.
- [Payroll System (Java 17 / JDBC / MVC+DAO)](https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/payroll-system-java): Automated batch payroll calculation engine complying with Brazilian progressive tax law (INSS and IRRF). Built in pure Java 17 with raw JDBC without ORM to enforce SQL and OOP fundamentals. Uses BigDecimal throughout for monetary precision, Singleton connection pooling, custom domain exceptions, and CSV export.
- [Aurora Growth Platform](https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/aurora-growth-platform): Mobile personal development app in React Native and Expo SDK 54. Features 3-tier hybrid navigation (Drawer, Stack, Tabs), Zod-validated forms via React Hook Form, and native device hardware access (Camera, GPS via Expo Location, Expo SecureStore, and QR code check-in).
- [Personal Portfolio (Angular 22 / Three.js)](https://devyurivieira.vercel.app/): High-performance portfolio engineered with Angular 22 standalone components, native Signals, and GPU-accelerated WebGL/Three.js particle shaders. Features formal Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), native browser RUM telemetry (PerformanceObserver Core Web Vitals), covered by 213 automated tests (158 Vitest unit tests, 38 Playwright E2E with Axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit, 17 Cypress E2E specs) and 100/100/100/100 desktop Lighthouse audit.
- [Django Full-Stack E-Commerce](https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/liquor-store-django): Production-grade e-commerce backend built with Python, Django 5, and Vanilla JavaScript. Features Service Layer architecture, atomic database transactions, idempotent asynchronous payment webhook handling (preventing duplicate charges), and N+1 query elimination via prefetch_related.
- [PlayStation Evolution Timeline](https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/playstation-evolution-timeline): Interactive 30-year hardware timeline (PS1 to PS5 Pro) built with React 18, TypeScript, Framer Motion, and CSS Modules, orchestrated via Intersection Observer (`rootMargin: "-50%"`) at a rock-solid 60 FPS.
- [Anime Weather Platform](https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/anime-weather-platform): Climate-aware entertainment recommendation engine combining real-time meteorological data (OpenWeather API), anime cultural catalog (Jikan API), and Google Gemini AI via prompt engineering within a glassmorphism React UI.
